facts.fact: The framework's passages refer to the National ICT Policy, 2016 (NICTP-2016) as an existing policy with subsequent reviews, and the President's statement says the National ICT Policy emphasizes the role of ICT in socio-economic goals; the framework is dated 2024, which is used as the as-of date.

note: The framework itself is a national digital strategy (class national), which gives no fact; the only sector-class fact is the reference to the National ICT Policy 2016.
